USE bankaml_gold;

CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE rapid_inout_flags
(
    account_id VARCHAR(20),	
    customer_id	VARCHAR(20), 
    inflow_txn_id VARCHAR(20), 
    outflow_txn_id VARCHAR(20),
    inflow_amount_usd DECIMAL(18,2),
    outflow_amount_usd DECIMAL(18,2),
    time_gap_hours DECIMAL(10,2),
    flag_type VARCHAR(20),
    severity VARCHAR(20),
    flagged_ts DATETIME,
    flag_id VARCHAR(100)
)
WITH (
    LOCATION = '__unitystorage/schemas/8946e759-3454-4f7d-ae7a-889f79f09120/tables/fbbeef28-96de-42a2-81e3-76dede14db39',
